headline: Late Night Doubts Trump Would Follow Through on $5,000 Payments
context: President Trump said he would give every American $5,000 if Republicans won the midterm elections. “The only catch is the money must be spent at the Mar-a-Lago gift shop,” Jimmy Fallon said.
